status: Prospective source contract; execution requires completed independent reviews, immutable source publication and exact remote verification.

scientificContract.unchanged: Physics, constants, preparation, exact hierarchy/global guard, canonical positive assembly, full solve/certificate/load checks and all four1e-8 tolerances retained. Filtered adds independently validated zero-filter metadata and work counters; all positive/rejected/unresolved scalar behavior remains exact fallback.
scientificContract.pairChecks: Independently classify all422560 nonself pairs per method across six scenes, including every implicit scalar zero, every filter zero and every eligible member of every node zero. Agreement and counts never replace the full oracle.
scientificContract.sceneOrderIdentityRule: Exact scene IDs and family/size positions fixed in this order.
scientificContract.expectedClass: admitted is a hypothesis independently checked for every scene; mismatch fails this cost qualification
scientificContract.sourceSupportBound: No positive-support reduction assumed. Conditional output bound charges every logical pair as potential nonzero in both methods; see allPairWireEnvelope.
scientificContract.literalStateFreeze: All17 binary64 input literals per drone, IDs and scene order are frozen before execution. Validate every literal/raw-word identity independently.

encoding.canonicalJson: Printable-ASCII-only JSON. Object keys sorted by ASCII byte order recursively; arrays preserve order; UTF-8 bytes; no whitespace; no duplicate keys. Allowed JSON values: null, booleans, printable ASCII strings(U+0020..U+007e), safe integers in[-9007199254740991,9007199254740991], arrays and objects. Reject floats, negative zero, NaN, Infinity, BigInt, undefined, non-ASCII and control characters. Escape only quote and backslash; no slash escaping. Scientific exact integers/timestamps obey their independent canonical-string rules. Node JSON.stringify over recursively key-sorted values and Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False) must agree after explicit value/type validation.
encoding.sha256: Lowercase64hex SHA-256 of exactly canonicalJson UTF-8 bytes unless the field explicitly pins raw file bytes.
encoding.integerString: 0 or -?[1-9][0-9]*; no +, leading zero or -0; positive denominator; reduce every fraction to gcd1.
encoding.timeString: 0 or [1-9][0-9]*; at most20digits; nanoseconds, never JSON floating point.
encoding.filePin: Exact raw on-disk byte length and SHA-256; no newline normalization or recanonicalization for file pins.
encoding.rawInputValue: Entire unchanged input object {drones:[{id,state:[17lowercase16hex]}]}, including unused velocity/angular components and declared input order.
encoding.methodDigestScientific: Whole unchanged method record, including assembly/proof/work; omit timing and trial metadata because they are separate records.
encoding.commonPositiveOrder: Input receiver, rotor0..3, input source; entries are exactly{i:stableID,r:rotor,j:stableID,coefficient:{l,u}}. Coefficient is the validated returned fixed96 interval. No status/branch wrapper in this common projection; whole method digest still binds status/branch.
encoding.sourceManifestSha256: SHA-256 of raw immutable source manifest bytes, excluding the manifest itself from its own file inventory. Supervisor and checker independently pin the same bytes.
encoding.specSha256: SHA-256 of raw immutable spec.json bytes.
encoding.parsedTypeValidation: Reject numeric float/constant tokens and the negative-zero integer token during saved-JSON parsing; reject duplicate keys and nonprintable strings recursively. Do not rely on Python float-to-int equality or loss of the lexical -0 sign. In Node reject Object.is(value,-0), unsafe/noninteger numbers, BigInt, undefined and nonplain/unsupported values before canonical encoding.
encoding.savedRunnerFileBytes: Index, paired scientific scene shards and the single anomaly wrapper use canonical JSON UTF-8 bytes plus exactly one trailing newline. Journal uses the same canonical bytes plus one newline per event. Saved checker rejects alternate key order, whitespace, escapes or line endings at successful index/shard/journal sites. File byte counts and SHA-256 include the newline. Digest envelopes use canonical bytes without newline.

storage.paths: Authoritative index results/timing-index.json; journal results/timing-index.json.jsonl; exactly6 paired shards results/scenes/<declaredSceneID>.json in spec order. Paths are relative to package attempt root and allowlisted exactly; reject escapes, duplicate paths, symlinks, missing/extra/reordered identities or unexpected scientific output files. First mismatch anomaly uses one fixed allowlisted results/anomalies/first-mismatch.json path and is forbidden in successful qualification.
storage.representativeSelection: First measured call for each method in each scene: local calls2 and3, respectively hierarchy and filtered. Never select fastest or last.
storage.sceneWrite: After the first measured pair completes, canonical-serialize the paired representative shard, create exclusively, write all bytes, fsync the file, make the directory entry durable, and append/fsync its pin event before the next method call. Retain no duplicate full scientific document in the journal.
storage.successfulIndex: Written exclusively only after all60 trials, all6 shard pins and all6 scene-complete records exist; exact index, ledger and journal consistency required. Finalization/durability failures leave the attempt failed.
storage.mismatch: Compare each freshly generated method digest with that method's first observed digest for the scene, including warmup. On the first mismatch, retain the current offending full scientific record in an exclusively created, fsynced failure shard; append/fsync a failure event with prior/current digests and offending pin; terminate allocation with failure and no retry. Warmup-to-representative mismatch is visible even if it occurs when first measured output is produced. No successful result index may be emitted.
storage.checkerLifetime: One scene scientific record, one independent all-pairs oracle/plans/roots/loads, at most one disposable method control copy; normalized schema projections share scientific values. Release them before next scene. No eager six-shard parse.
storage.kernelLifetime: Retain only current scene's two representative method records plus current trial result until digest comparison. Release nonrepresentative result after successful hashing and journaling. After scene completion release representatives; final index retains pins/metadata only.
storage.checkerEvidence: Compact independent-check.json plus six reference-scenes/<sceneId>.json, bounded together by128MiB. At most eighteen bounded control witnesses. One scene oracle/record and at most one disposable method control copy; schema projections share scientific values and do not duplicate the full record.
storage.mismatchResourceFailure: Byte caps take precedence over full anomaly retention. Before exclusive anomaly write, determine required canonical record bytes and remaining per-file/scientific/aggregate capacity. If full record cannot fit, fail as anomaly-retention-resource, retain bounded prior/current digest and required/available-byte evidence, and do not write a truncated scientific record. This is an unsuccessful allocation with incomplete anomaly retention explicitly reported, never a pass or retry. This accepted precedence is necessary because arbitrary erroneous output need not obey successful-science bounds.

trialProtocol.sequence: Global0-based index0..59 in authoritative actual call order; sceneIndex0..5; warmup phase repetition0; measured phase repetitions1..4; pairPosition0..1. Require exact frozen sequence before other ledger checks.
trialProtocol.clock: process.hrtime.bigint; one kernel origin sampled before shared literal input conversion; startNs/endNs are nonnegative offsets from that same origin
trialProtocol.methodBoundary: Start immediately before synchronous method(rawWords,name), before raw validation. Both methods prepare independently and build the identical exact hierarchy/global guard. Filtered preparation additionally builds fast singleton data from the same admitted prepared words. All filter preparation, attempts, exact fallbacks, canonical assembly, full solve and complete certificate are charged. Existing prepared/spatial/assembled hooks and outer completed stamp apply. No asynchronous outstanding work.
trialProtocol.phaseAccounting: Same3 internal hooks in same order for both methods; completed offset is outer return stamp. No per-pair stamps. All hook/outer stamp overhead is charged, none subtracted. 0<=prepared<=spatial<=assembled<=completed=totalNs=endNs-startNs; totalNs>0. stagesNs equals[prepared,spatial-prepared,assembled-spatial,completed-assembled] exactly. Zero individual stages allowed. Phase errors fail.
trialProtocol.chronology: Every trial start/end is serial and nonoverlapping across the full run in declared actual order. Every inputConversionTiming precedes its scene's first trial; every trial harness start>=method end and harness end<=next method start. Per-scene input conversion begins after previous scene's final method/harness interval. Store no wall-clock claims as monotonic duration.
trialProtocol.harnessAccounting: After method return, start harness interval before digest-context/common-payload projection; construct and canonical-serialize method/common envelopes; stamp; SHA-256 them; end stamp. serializationNs+hashNs=totalNs=endNs-startNs>=0, each component nonnegative. Common input literal-to-word conversion has separate per-scene interval fields. No timing inside scientific digests.
trialProtocol.recordedHarnessScope: Input literal conversion and per-call scientific canonical serialization/hash are timed separately. File/journal fsync, supervisor, final index/shard serialization and other orchestration are outside the reported method and named harness intervals; disclose that scope. Do not call their sum full wall-clock run cost.
trialProtocol.binding: For every trial recompute expected method/common digest from retained first-measured representative and frozen context; compare every digest, including warmups. Compare every work field with independently reconstructed method work. Reject missing/extra/repeated calls, wrong phase/order/repetition/method/scene/context/digest/work. No trial-to-trial equality-only acceptance.
trialProtocol.summary: Exactly six scene-order summaries. Each measured ratio=filteredNs/hierarchyNs. Report exact medians of four durations, medianPairedRatio as median of four reduced ratios, and ratioOfMedians=filteredMedianNs/hierarchyMedianNs. Warmups excluded only from comparisons; no adaptive repeats or outlier deletion. winCount counts strict filtered<hierarchy measured pairs; practicalBenefitPassed is medianPairedRatio<=9/10 and winCount>=3; primaryBenefitPassed is conjunction for exactly the first three dense scenes. False benefit booleans do not invalidate scientific qualification.

journal.encoding: One bounded canonical ASCII JSON object per line; append-only, exclusive attempt file; flush and fsync each completed event before next method call. Reject partial/trailing lines on successful qualification. After exclusive journal creation, fsync its parent directory before any next method call, so the journal pathname is durable as well as each appended event.
journal.trialCompletePayload: Exactly the full immutable trial record; fsync each of60 completed calls, including warmups.
journal.representativeShardPayload: Exactly the final matching scene descriptor, after local calls2 and3 and before call4; file and directory durability precede event durability.
journal.failedNullableFields: For failure before mismatch evidence exists, relevant contextual/pin/byte fields may be null; error reason must identify the precise failure. anomaly-retention-resource records required/available bytes and digests, with null offending file pin because no complete anomaly exists. Never fabricate unavailable evidence.
journal.order: run-start; for each scene input-ready, trial0,trial1,trial2,trial3,representative-shard,trial4..trial9,scene-complete; then run-complete. Failure may terminate prefix with run-failed. Journal trial records equal authoritative index trial records exactly. Exact6 shard descriptors equal index descriptors. Successful run-complete pins raw result index bytes; the result index does not contain its own hash.

controls.selection: First qualifying witness in frozen scene order. Original fifteen controls use off hierarchy. Three new controls use filtered. Receiver, rotor, deterministic terminal, then input source order; root/load witnesses use input drone then rotor. Missing required witness across all six scenes fails; no new cases or retries.
controls.execution: Validate originals first. For each control use one method-local copy and the identical new-filter-plus-inherited semantic validator before digest/equality checks. Require the intended independent failure prefix. Metadata recipes use the identical index/ledger/binding validator. Source projection removes only new metadata after validating its exact keys, oracle branches and counters.
controls.candidateIdentityOrder: Within the same certificate validator, validate parsed candidate exact load identities before row-defect/root validation; then retain all inherited row/root/full-load-box/error checks. This order lets altered-candidate control prove its intended identity failure without changing mathematical acceptance.

wireLimits.accounting: Six paired science shards plus at most one first-mismatch anomaly share384MiB; each file128MiB. Checker report and six reference files share128MiB; index8MiB,journal8MiB,metadata/private-and-public logs16MiB,aggregate768MiB. Byte caps are fail-closed, never truncation/retry. Generic all-pair wire envelope below uses no old support-count claim; anomaly retention may fail on remaining capacity and must be reported as failed allocation. No source envelope proves RSS or completion feasibility.

fractionEmissionInventory.site: Independent root/load/tree evidence and inherited eight scientific control witnesses
fractionEmissionInventory.bound: Unchanged independent exact parser and generated rational rejection caps:256characters for reference/witness/load integers,108characters fixed96,tree numerator310/denominator324. No prior scene-specific exponent, support, root-margin or RSS proof is inherited. Any cap breach fails qualification without truncation.
One fixed192 coefficient interval or exact status/branch plus safe integer indices; serialized witness <=65536bytes. Wrong-branch witness adds no rational values.
At most20digit timestamp integer operands; exact reduced ratios and four-sample medians. No floating summaries or confidence inference.

evidencePolicy: Only bounded reference/control evidence is emitted. Every parser and wire rejection cap stays enforced. Inherited mathematical certificate checks remain unchanged. Old scene-specific numerical/storage proofs are not claimed; generic all-pair envelope is a conditional serialized-output bound only.
qualificationLimits: Scientific qualification, digest consistency, timing integrity and practicalBenefit are separate. All exact loads and four1e-8 tolerances must pass in every scene/method. PracticalBenefit requires each dense scene medianPairedRatio<=9/10 and at least three strict filtered<hierarchy wins among four measured pairs. Sparse results contextual. No moving dynamics, browser5000 scale, physical validity, novelty or general speedup claim.
query: {i:original input receiver index,r:rotor0..3,terminals:[terminal]}; input receiver then rotor order
scan: {kind:scan,entries:[{j,result}],zeroCount,filterZeros:[{j,branch}]}; entries and filterZeros each strictly input-j sorted and disjoint. Every reported filter zero belongs to this eligible nonself scan and matches the independent oracle zero branch. Off hierarchy requires empty filterZeros.
leaf: {kind:leaf,node,entries:[{j,result}],zeroCount,filterZeros:[{j,branch}]}; same filtering rules, membership restricted to the exact declared leaf. zeroCount includes all missing zero sources, whether filtered or exact.
zero: {kind:zero,node:preorder ID,rule:declared first valid proof,count:exact nonself member count}; empty self-only coverage allowed and counted as actual traversal
positiveResult: {status:positive,branch:active,coefficient:{l,u}}; all positive exact-domain/cap conditions independently checked; coefficient contains fixed192 independent reference
refusedResult: {status:rejected|unresolved,branch}; no permitted unresolved or stress exception in this suite
globalGuard: null or {passed:boolean,checks:{centerComponent:boolean,centerNorm:boolean,rotorComponent:boolean,down:boolean,radial:boolean}}; all checks evaluated independently; completed false proof alone chooses fallback
tree: {permutation:[stableID],nodes:[{id,start,end,left,right,center,axis}]}; center/axis each3 arrays [lowerRational,upperRational]; exact extrema; preorder; leaf incoming order retained; root<=8 preserves input order
indexPolicy: Query i and entry j are original input indices. Prepared/solve/load IDs, tree permutation and canonical result witness i/j are stable IDs. Canonical outcome order is input receiver/rotor/input-source, never traversal order.
preparation: All drones prepared independently per method before self exclusion. Both use the same admitted raw/native words and exact global guard/tree. The filter is prepared only for filtered from those same admitted words. This fixed suite requires every scene admitted; unresolved/refused outcomes fail qualification.
commonResult: {status:certified|tolerance-failed|rejected|unresolved|resource,branch,witness:null|{id}|{i,r,j},toleranceAchieved:null|boolean}; inherited canonical priority; no source/reference expectedClass oracle
solve: null or {iterations:48,bisections:54,candidate:[{id:stableID,x:4lowercase16hex}]}; candidate untrusted finite0<x<=1; no independent native proposal replay
certificateChecks: Full returned coefficient boxes and exact candidate-derived source enclosure cover complete s; p encloses xhat^3+xhat*returned s; kbar>=max(1,pU,1/pL), pL>0, Kbar>=all kbar; roots contain exact corollary and independent fixed192/fixed128 reference; exact candidate loads; signed load boxes cover entire returned root box and independent reference; all3 full-box Euclidean norm error proofs; exact mg/4,mg,mg*R; upper*100000000<=2^96
interval: {l,u} canonical signed integer strings /2^96; ordered endpoints in[-2^352,2^352]; <=108characters each
rational: Canonical reduced{n,d}; load and generated reference/witness integers<=256characters; candidate tree numerator<=310,denominator<=324characters; positive denominator.
filterZero: {j:original input source index,branch:neighbor|upstream|down-cut|near-outside|radial|projection}; exact oracle status zero and exact priority branch required; no duplicate source, no nonmember, no overlap with entries, no list on node-zero terminal.
filterWork: filterPrepared=N for filtered and0 for hierarchy; filterAttempts=scalarPairs for filtered and0 for hierarchy; filterZeros=validated list lengths for filtered and0 for hierarchy; exactScalarCalls=scalarPairs-filterZeros for filtered and scalarPairs for hierarchy. scalarPairs and scalarZeroPairs retain inherited logical residual-pair meanings. All original work counters independently reconstruct from the exact hierarchy plan.

benefitRule.qualification: Report practicalBenefit separately. Scientific correctness and timing integrity do not depend on a speed win.

allPairWireEnvelope.rule: Each logical pair contributes at most two nonzero entries of384bytes plus comma; a filtered zero record96bytes is disjoint from nonzero entries and replaces this charge. No bound on positive support is used. Each deterministic half-split tree has the structural leaf count shown; terminal overhead128bytes,query64bytes,node8193bytes,certificate row1025bytes,load12289bytes; raw/both prepared/solve input4096bytes per drone and per-scene envelope65536bytes. Actual runtime byte caps still enforced.
allPairWireEnvelope.scope: Conditional generic serialization bound for valid frozen wire records; no anomaly reserve, reference-size feasibility, RSS or timing proof.

assemblyMode: hierarchy for off exact-tree mode, filtered for on exact-tree mode; fallback and global-preparation unchanged. Checker validates exact original name/mode then maps both to inherited hierarchy semantic validation.
